prompt: Create a map of Europe showing the major climate regions: Mediterranean, oceanic, continental, subarctic, tundra, and mountain climate. Use separate filled regions, label major seas and selected countries for orientation, and include a legend.

spec.title: Major Climate Regions of Europe
spec.subtitle: Based on Köppen-Geiger Classification (2020–2024)

sources.title: World Maps of Köppen-Geiger Climate Classification
EEA - Observed Climate Zones in Europe
JRC - IPCC Climate Zones for Europe

notes: Disputed territories are shown according to international conventions (UN, EU).
Climate boundaries are simplified for readability and based on 2020–2024 data.
spec.referenceSummary: This map depicts Europe's major climate regions using the Köppen-Geiger classification, sourced from the European Environment Agency and academic climate research (2020–2024).
